1415.commentary: (SNa) ajjhogāḷhappatto'ti ogāhappatto. (ANa) ajjhogāḷho'ti udake anupaviṭṭho. (NIDD1a) ajjhogāḷho'ti adhi-ogāhitvā avattharitvā visesena paviṭṭho

examples.text: sineru, bhikkhave, pabbatarājā caturāsītiyojanasahassāni āyāmena, caturāsītiyojanasahassāni vitthārena, caturāsītiyojanasahassāni mahāsamudde ajjhogāḷho, caturāsītiyojanasahassāni mahāsamuddā accuggato.

1416.commentary: (SNa) ajjhogāḷhappatto'ti ogāhappatto. so kira satthu santike kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ pavisitvā dutiyadivase gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi pāsādikehi abhikkant'ādīhi. aññataraṃ kulaṃ tassa iriyāpathe pasīditvā pañcapatiṭṭhitena vanditvā piṇḍapātaṃ adāsi. bhatt'ānumodanaṃ puna sutvā atirekataraṃ pasīditvā, bhante, niccakālaṃ idh'eva bhikkhaṃ gaṇhathā'ti nimantesi. thero adhivāsetvā tesaṃ āhāraṃ paribhuñjamāno vīriyaṃ paggayha ghaṭento arahattaṃ patvā cintesi, bah'ūpakāraṃ me etaṃ kulaṃ, aññattha gantvā kiṃ karissāmī'ti? phalasamāpattisukhaṃ anubhavanto tatth'eva vasi.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena so bhikkhu aññatarasmiṃ kule ativelaṃ ajjhogāḷhappatto viharati.
sace'pi tattha khīraṃ vā rasaṃ vā ākiranti, yena ajjhotthataṃ bhattaṃ ekarasaṃ hoti, koṭito paṭṭhāya bhuñjantassa anāpattī'ti mahāpaccariyaṃ vuttaṃ.
tamokhandhena āvuṭā'ti avijjārāsinā ajjhotthatā.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū sīmāya sīmaṃ ajjhottharanti.

1420.meaning1: embraces; smothers; lies on top of

udānaṃ udānesī'ti udāhāraṃ udāhari. yathā hi yaṃ telaṃ mānaṃ gahetuṃ na sakkoti, vissanditvā gacchati, taṃ avaseko'ti vuccati, yañ'ca jalaṃ taḷākaṃ gahetuṃ na sakkoti, ajjhottharitvā gacchati, taṃ ogho'ti vuccati.

1424.meaning1: being embraced; being smothered; being lain on top of (by)
1424.construction: adhi > adhy > ajjh + ava + thariya + māna

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuṃ araññagataṃ vā rukkhamūlagataṃ vā suññāgāragataṃ vā mātugāmo upasaṅkamitvā abhinisīdati abhinipajjati ajjhottharati. so mātugāmena abhinisīdiyamāno abhinipajjiyamāno ajjhotthariyamāno sikkhaṃ apaccakkhāya dubbalyaṃ anāvikatvā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevati.

1426.commentary: (DNa) ajjhopannā'ti adhi-opannā ogāḷhā, idaṃ sāran'ti pariniṭṭhānappattā hutvā. (MNa) ajjhopannā'ti taṇhāya ajjhogāḷhā.

examples.text: tesaṃ gihī pasann'ākāraṃ karonti. te taṃ lābhaṃ gadhitā mucchitā ajjhopannā anādīnavadassāvino anissaraṇapaññā paribhuñjanti.

1427.meaning1: crushes down; smashes down; tramples down
1427.construction: adhi > adhy > ajjh + ava + madda + ti

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko, pehī'ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā rath'īsāya satthiṃ ussajjitvā rath'īsaṃ'y'eva ajjhomaddati. evarūpo'pi, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko hoti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, tatiyo assadoso.

1428.meaning1: utterly obsessed; completely infatuated (with); strongly fixated (on)
1428.commentary: (ANa) ajjhomucchito'ti adhi-omucchito gilitvā pariniṭṭhapetvā gahaṇasabhāvāya atirekamucchāya taṇhāya samannāgato. (ANt) ajjhomucchito'ti adhimattāya taṇhāmucchāya mucchito, mucchaṃ mohaṃ pamādaṃ āpanno.

examples.text: so bhaddāya deviyā kālaṅ'katāya piyāya manāpāya n'eva nhāyati na vilimpati na bhattaṃ bhuñjati na kamm'antaṃ payojeti, rattin'divaṃ bhaddāya deviyā sarīre ajjhomucchito.

1429.construction: adhi > adhy > ajjh + ava + lamba + ti
1429.commentary: (SNa) ajjholambeyyun'ti te tīre jātā'pi onamitvā aggehi udakaṃ phusantehi adhi-olambeyyuṃ, upari lambeyyun'ti attho.

examples.text: tassā ubhosu tīresu kāsā ce'pi jātā assu, te naṃ ajjholambeyyuṃ, kusā ce'pi jātā assu, te naṃ ajjholambeyyuṃ, pabbajā ce'pi jātā assu, te naṃ ajjholambeyyuṃ, bīraṇā ce'pi jātā assu, te naṃ ajjholambeyyuṃ, rukkhā ce'pi jātā assu, te naṃ ajjholambeyyuṃ.

1430.meaning1: clinging; attaching; fixating; obsessing; holding tightly
1430.commentary: (THa) tathābhūto ca tañ'ca ajjhosa tiṭṭhatī'ti tañ'ca rūp'ārammaṇaṃ ajjhosāya sukhaṃ sukhan'ti abhinivissa gilitvā pariniṭṭhāpetvā tiṭṭhati.

examples.text: rūpaṃ disvā sati muṭṭhā, piyaṃ nimittaṃ manasi karoto, sārattacitto vedeti, tañ'ca ajjhosa tiṭṭhati.

1431.construction: adhi > adhy > ajjh + ava + sa + ti

1435.commentary: (MNa) ajjhosāya tiṭṭhatī'ti taṇhā-ajjhosānagahaṇena gilitvā pariniṭṭhapetvā gaṇhāti. sukhaṃ vā adukkham'asukhaṃ vā abhinandatu, dukkhaṃ kathaṃ abhinandatī'ti? ahaṃ dukkhito mama dukkhan'ti gaṇhanto abhinandati nāma.

examples.text: santi kho, puṇṇa, cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kām'ūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā. tañ'ce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati. tassa taṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandī.
so evaṃ anurodhavirodhaṃ samāpanno yaṃ kiñci vedanaṃ vedeti sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham'asukhaṃ vā, so taṃ vedanaṃ abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.

examples.text: yatonidānaṃ, bhikkhu, purisaṃ papañcasaññāsaṅkhā samudācaranti. ettha ce n'atthi abhinanditabbaṃ abhivaditabbaṃ ajjhositabbaṃ.

so doṇiyā baddho na, yavasaṃ yavasan'ti jhāyati. bhadro hi, sandha, ass'ājānīyo yathā iṇaṃ yathā bandhaṃ yathā jāniṃ yathā kaliṃ evaṃ patodassa ajjhoharaṇaṃ samanupassati.

1447.meaning2: fit to be swallowed or eaten

examples.text: dvattikkhattuṃ kho bhavaṃ gotamo mukhe ālopaṃ samparivattetvā ajjhoharati, na c'assa kāci odanamiñjā asambhinnā kāyaṃ pavisati, na c'assa kāci odanamiñjā mukhe avasiṭṭhā hoti, ath'āparaṃ ālopaṃ upanāmeti.
te taṃ sarasiṃ ogāhetvā soṇḍāya bhisamuḷālaṃ abbuhetvā suvikkhālitaṃ vikkhāletvā akaddamaṃ saṅkhāditvā ajjhoharanti.
atha kho so, bhikkhave, mudumūsi gocarāya pakkāmi. tam'enaṃ biḷāro gahetvā sahasā asaṅkhāditvā ajjhohari. tassa so mudumūsi antam'pi khādi, antaguṇam'pi khādi.

1450.commentary: (VISMa) cakkhussa āpāthaṃ atītattā ajjhoharitabbo hotī'ti ukkaṃsagataṃ tassa paṭikkūlabhāvaṃ vibhāveti.

examples.text: so evaṃ vicuṇṇitamakkhito taṅ'khaṇaññ'eva antarahita-vaṇṇa-gandha-saṅkhāra-viseso suvānadoṇiyaṃ ṭhitasuvānavamathu viya paramajegucchabhāvaṃ upagacchati. evarūpo'pi samāno cakkhussa āpāthaṃ atītattā ajjhoharitabbo hotī'ti evaṃ paribhogato paṭikkūlatā paccavekkhitabbā.
nissaṭṭhaṃ paṭilabhitvā na kāyikena paribhogena paribhuñjitabbaṃ, na ajjhoharitabbaṃ, padīpe vā kāḷavaṇṇe vā upanetabbaṃ, aññena bhikkhunā kāyikena paribhogena paribhuñjitabbaṃ, na ajjhoharitabbaṃ.

agilānena bhikkhunā sakiṃ bhuñjitabbo. tato ce uttari, bhuñjissāmī'ti paṭiggaṇhāti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. ajjhohāre ajjhohāre āpatti pācittiyassa.

1455.construction: adhi > adhy > ajjh + ava + hāre + ti

aṭṭhapadakatā kesā, nettā añjanamakkhitā, alaṃ bālassa mohāya, no ca pāragavesino.

1468.commentary: (THa) nettā añjanamakkhitā'ti ubho'pi nayanāni anto dvīsu antesu ca yathā añjanacchāyā dissati, evaṃ añjit'añjanāni.

1470.meaning1: black wood; dark forest; place name

examples.text: ekam'id'āhaṃ, āvuso, samayaṃ sākete viharāmi añjanavane migadāye. atha kho, āvuso, jaṭilavāsikā bhikkhunī yen'āhaṃ ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
anāpatti gaṇṭhikāya, araṇike, vidhe, añjaniyā, añjanisalākāya, vāsijaṭe, udakapuñchaniyā, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

1475.meaning1: make-up box; ointment box; (comm) collyrium tube
1475.commentary: (THa) añjanī'va navā cittā, pūtikāyo alaṅ'kato'ti yathā añjanī añjananāḷikā navā abhinavā mālākamma-makaradant'ādi-vasena cittā bahi maṭṭhā ujjalā dassanīyā, anto pana na dassanīyā hoti, evam'eva tāsaṃ kāyo nhān'abbhañjana-vatth'ālaṅ'kārehi alaṅ'kato bahi ujjalo, anto pana pūti nānappakāra-asucīhi bharito tiṭṭhatī'ti attho.

examples.text: añjanī'va navā cittā, pūtikāyo alaṅ'kato. alaṃ bālassa mohāya, no ca pāragavesino.
anāpatti gaṇṭhikāya, araṇike, vidhe, añjaniyā, añjanisalākāya, vāsijaṭe, udakapuñchaniyā, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

1478.meaning1: palms placed together (as a token of respect)
1478.meaning2: lifting of the folded hands as a token of reverence

examples.text: tena kuṭikārakena bhikkhunā kuṭivatthuṃ sodhetvā saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā vuḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam'assa vacanīyo

tassa heṭṭhābhāgaṃ sodhāpetvā pākāraparikkhepaṃ kārāpetvā vālukaṃ okirāpetvā dhajapaṭākaṃ ussāpetvā vanappatiṃ alaṅ'karitvā añjaliṃ karitvā, sace puttaṃ vā dhītaraṃ vā labheyyaṃ, tumhākaṃ mahāsakkāraṃ karissāmī'ti patthanaṃ katvā pakkāmi.

1479.meaning1: hands cupped together (to drink water or hold some item)

examples.text: so taṃ pokkharaṇiṃ ogāhetvā ubhohi hatthehi itic'iti ca sevālapaṇakaṃ apaviyūhitvā añjalinā pivitvā pakkameyya.
seyyathā'pi, devānam'inda, gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre mahādhaññarāsi. tato mahājanakāyo dhaññaṃ āhareyya, kājehi'pi piṭakehi'pi ucchaṅgehi'pi añjalīhi'pi.

1481.meaning1: respectful salutation; greeting with palms joined together
1481.commentary: (MNa) ācariyaṃ pana disvā añjaliṃ paggayha sīse ṭhapetvā ācariyaṃ namassati, yasmiṃ vā disābhāge so vasati, tadabhimukho'pi tath'eva namassati, gacchanto'pi ṭhito'pi nisinno'pi añjaliṃ paggayha namassati'y'evā'ti idaṃ añjalikammaṃ nāma.

examples.text: cattāro'me, mahārāja, vaṇṇā, khattiyā, brāhmaṇā, vessā, suddā. imesaṃ kho, mahārāja, catunnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ dve vaṇṇā aggam'akkhāyanti, khattiyā ca brāhmaṇā ca, yadidaṃ abhivādana-paccuṭṭhāna-añjalikamma-sāmīcikammānī'ti.

vassasat'ūpasampannāya bhikkhuniyā tadah'upasampannassa bhikkhuno abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ kātabbaṃ, ayam'pi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.

1482.meaningLit: to be paid respect with hands

examples.text: yadidaṃ cattāri purisayugāni aṭṭha purisapuggalā, esa bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā'ti
evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭhahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.

1483.meaning2: folded fingers, in order to retain something in

1484.grammar: idiom, fem + abs, abs of añjaliṃ karoti (+dat)
1484.meaning1: having paid respect (to) with palms together; having reverently saluted

examples.text: saṅghassa añjaliṃ katvā, idh'ekacce vadām'ahaṃ, apaviddhā anāthā te, yathā petā tath'eva te.

1485.meaning2: pays respect (to) with palms together; reverently salutes

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso araññe pavane caramāno passeyya purāṇaṃ maggaṃ purāṇ'añjasaṃ pubbakehi manussehi anuyātaṃ.
adaṃsu te mam'okāsaṃ, sodhetuṃ añjasaṃ tadā, buddho buddho'ti cintento, maggaṃ sodhem'ahaṃ tadā.

1488.commentary: (DNa) añjas'āyano'ti ujumaggass'etaṃ vevacanaṃ, añjasā vā ujukam'eva etena āyanti āgacchantī'ti añjas'āyano

examples.text: atha kho vāseṭṭho māṇavo evam'āha, ayam'eva ujumaggo, ayam'añjas'āyano niyyāniko niyyāti takkarassa brahmasahabyatāya, yv'āyaṃ akkhāto brāhmaṇena pokkharasātinā'ti.

1493.meaning1: having put on eyeshadow; having applied collyrium

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā nando bhagavato mātucchāputto ākoṭitapaccākoṭitāni cīvarāni pārupitvā akkhīni añjetvā acchaṃ pattaṃ gahetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.
vuccati cittaṃ iti'pi, mano iti'pi, viññāṇaṃ iti'pi, taṃ rattiyā ca divasassa ca añña'd'eva uppajjati aññaṃ nirujjhati.
aññā hi lābh'ūpanisā, aññā nibbānagāminī, evam'etaṃ abhiññāya, bhikkhu buddhassa sāvako, sakkāraṃ n'ābhinandeyya, vivekam'anubrūhaye.

1497.meaning1: another; other; different; someone else; not oneself

examples.text: sorato hoti sukhasaṃvāso, na aññe bhikkhū ubbejetā.
kummo aṅgāni sake kapāle, samodahaṃ bhikkhu manovitakke, anissito aññam'aheṭhayāno, parinibbuto n'ūpavadeyya kañcī'ti.

1498.meaning1: something more; something further; something else

examples.text: yaṃ taṃ apucchimha akittayī no, aññaṃ taṃ pucchāma tadiṅgha brūhi, ettāvat'aggaṃ nu vadanti h'eke, yakkhassa suddhiṃ idha paṇḍitāse, udāhu aññam'pi vadanti etto.
eso hi, bhikkhu, brahmā mahābrahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthu'daso vasavattī issaro kattā nimmātā seṭṭho sajitā vasī pitā bhūtabhabyānaṃ.
